            i, d, f = g.b(i, d, f)
            local a, j
            a, j = i(d, f)
            if a ~= nil then
                while true do
                    j = {[3] = 1, [1] = j}
                    j[2] = j
                    if j[1] and j[1].Parent then
                        g._[g.Kx[8557] or "pcall"](g:Rw({
                            c[3],
                            c[2],
                            j,
                        }))
                    end
                    a, j = i(d, f)
                    f = a
                    if f == nil then
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            c[1][1]()
        end
    end,
